FM05.reasoning: The dataset has a temporal component (activation_date), but random cross-validation ignores the time ordering, introducing look-ahead bias in the validation metrics.

other_failure_modes.name: Invalid Submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops the true identifier column from the test set and replaces it with a synthetic integer sequence for the submission file. This will result in a scoring error as the IDs will not match the expected format or values.

other_failure_modes.name: Computational Timeout
other_failure_modes.description: The training pipeline is excessively computationally expensive (e.g., fitting 15 Ridge models on large sparse matrices and 10 large LightGBM models), leading to an execution timeout before completion.

summary: The agent builds a well-structured LightGBM pipeline with extensive feature engineering, including target encoding and OOF TF-IDF features. However, it fails critically by generating fake submission IDs, which will cause the submission to fail scoring entirely. Additionally, it suffers from moderate data leakage by fitting TF-IDF on the combined train and test sets, and by failing to group by user or respect temporal order during cross-validation.
